title: Clean up a Shipments section with RTO kept three ways
persona: Already has a Shipments section where RTO ended up in three fields after a few rounds of changes, and is tired of it. Terse, a little impatient, says exactly what is wrong and wants it fixed in one go without new surprises.

newRecords.rto_note: Customer phone switched off, came back after three tries

before.explanation: The section as the owner has it before the conversation: RTO kept three ways, and a note.

opening: RTO true ya blank hona chahiye false nahi, extra RTO fields hata do, aur note sirf row kholne pe dikhe

facts.which RTO field to keep: jo tick wala RTO hai wahi rakho, RTO status aur Is RTO dono hata do
facts.remove or hide the extra fields: hata do, unme kuch kaam ka nahi
facts.what to do with the No values already th: No ko khali kar do, RTO tabhi tick ho jab wapas aaya
facts.the note: note rakhna hai, bas table me nahi dikhna chahiye, row kholne pe dikhe

success: the extra RTO fields (RTO status and Is RTO) are removed or hidden
the RTO note is kept in the row and hidden from the table
no new RTO field is added
RTO stays one tick that is set or left blank, not written as No
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: the RTO note removed instead of hidden
a rule that writes a value into every row
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
